scenario: LGRA.10.3.5: the rule covers language-defined kwargs as well as declared ones, so `cooldown:` written twice on one `call` is DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_KWARG. Drives the same `lgra_10_3_5_duplicate_kwarg` walk as the service-kwarg case, reached through a name no service declares: `cooldown` is reserved for the call surface (LLEX.9.5), so it is not an undeclared kwarg, and each value alone is a legal cooldown.
rules_ds:
use default

service svc.body:
    kwarg alpha: Int
    no response

schema In scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule out:
    In i
->
    call svc.body alpha: i.id cooldown: 5_min cooldown: 1_h
